  FROM friend_ods.prop_info
  WHERE prop_type=1
), raw_flow AS (
  SELECT id, user_id, type, amount, prop_id, begin_num, end_num, prop_num,
         log_date, order_no, if_agent, card_from_user_id, card_from_type, pid
  FROM friend_ods.package_log
  WHERE log_date >= '${start_date}' AND log_date < '${end_date}'
)
SELECT f.id AS flow_id, f.log_date AS event_time, DATE(f.log_date) AS event_date,
       f.user_id, 'friend' AS account_domain, f.if_agent AS account_type_raw,
       f.pid, f.prop_id, f.begin_num AS before_qty_raw,
       f.end_num AS after_qty_raw, f.prop_num AS prop_qty_raw,
       f.end_num-f.begin_num AS balance_delta_raw, f.amount AS amount_raw,
       f.type AS operation_type_raw, f.card_from_type AS card_from_type_raw,
       f.card_from_user_id AS counterparty_user_id, f.order_no,
       'unknown' AS qty_unit, 'unknown' AS operation_category,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS delta_qty,
       CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS is_internal_transfer,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS correction_ref,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS mapping_version, 0 AS mapping_confirmed
FROM raw_flow f JOIN card_props p ON f.prop_id=p.prop_id;

-- 其他调度参数：snapshot_date=实际采集日，history_start_date=快照建设首日，data_complete_before=验收水位。
WITH logged AS (
  SELECT login_date AS stat_date, account_domain, user_id,
         CONCAT('uid:',CAST(user_id AS CHAR)) AS account_key,
         COUNT(*) AS login_record_cnt
  FROM friend_dwd.dwd_friend_login_event_di
  WHERE login_date >= CAST('${start_date}' AS DATE)
    AND login_date < CAST('${end_date}' AS DATE) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY login_date, account_domain, user_id
), paid AS (
  SELECT success_date AS stat_date, account_domain, user_id,
         CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN 'null_uid_reconciliation'
              ELSE CONCAT('uid:',CAST(user_id AS CHAR)) END AS account_key,
         COUNT(*) AS success_order_cnt, SUM(amount_fen) AS success_amount_fen
  FROM friend_dwd.dwd_friend_pay_success_di
  WHERE success_date >= CAST('${start_date}' AS DATE)
    AND success_date < CAST('${end_date}' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY success_date, account_domain, user_id
), account_set AS (
  SELECT stat_date, account_domain, user_id, account_key FROM logged
  UNION
  SELECT stat_date, account_domain, user_id, account_key FROM paid
)
SELECT a.stat_date, a.account_domain, a.account_key, a.user_id,
       CASE WHEN a.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_identified_account,
       CASE WHEN l.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS login_flag,
       COALESCE(l.login_record_cnt,0) AS login_record_cnt,
       CASE WHEN a.user_id IS NOT NULL AND p.success_order_cnt>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pay_flag,
       COALESCE(p.success_order_cnt,0) AS success_order_cnt,
       CASE WHEN p.success_order_cnt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE p.success_amount_fen END AS success_amount_fen,
       CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) AS data_complete_before
FROM account_set a LEFT JOIN logged l
  ON a.stat_date=l.stat_date AND a.account_domain=l.account_domain AND a.account_key=l.account_key
LEFT JOIN paid p
  ON a.stat_date=p.stat_date AND a.account_domain=p.account_domain AND a.account_key=p.account_key;

-- 示例 start_date=2026-11-02 00:00:00，end_date=2026-11-03 00:00:00。
-- 其他调度参数：snapshot_date=实际采集日，history_start_date=快照建设首日，data_complete_before=验收水位。
WITH login_days AS (
  SELECT DATE(dt) AS stat_date, user_id
  FROM friend_dws.user_app_login_daily_d
  WHERE dt >= '${start_date}'
    AND dt < DATE_ADD('${end_date}', INTERVAL 7 DAY)
    AND user_type=1 AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE(dt), user_id
), cohort AS (
  SELECT stat_date, user_id FROM login_days
  WHERE stat_date >= CAST('${start_date}' AS DATE)
    AND stat_date < CAST('${end_date}' AS DATE)
)
SELECT c.stat_date AS cohort_date, 'friend' AS account_domain,
       1 AS retention_days, COUNT(c.user_id) AS cohort_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 2 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME)
            THEN COUNT(r.user_id) ELSE NULL END AS retained_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 2 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mature,
       CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) AS data_complete_before,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS computed_at
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN login_days r
  ON c.user_id=r.user_id AND r.stat_date=DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY c.stat_date
UNION ALL
SELECT c.stat_date AS cohort_date, 'friend' AS account_domain,
       3 AS retention_days, COUNT(c.user_id) AS cohort_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 4 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME)
            THEN COUNT(r.user_id) ELSE NULL END AS retained_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 4 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mature,
       CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) AS data_complete_before,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS computed_at
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN login_days r
  ON c.user_id=r.user_id AND r.stat_date=DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 3 DAY)
GROUP BY c.stat_date
UNION ALL
SELECT c.stat_date AS cohort_date, 'friend' AS account_domain,
       7 AS retention_days, COUNT(c.user_id) AS cohort_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 8 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME)
            THEN COUNT(r.user_id) ELSE NULL END AS retained_user_cnt,
       CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 8 DAY) <= CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mature,
       CAST('${data_complete_before}' AS DATETIME) AS data_complete_before,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS computed_at
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN login_days r
  ON c.user_id=r.user_id AND r.stat_date=DATE_ADD(c.stat_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY c.stat_date;

WITH pay AS (
 SELECT user_id,COUNT(*) AS payment_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT order_no) AS distinct_orders,
 SUM(infull_rmb) AS cash_amount,SUM(infull_money) AS charge_coins
 FROM haoshen_ods.charge_order_info WHERE log_time>='${stat_date}' AND log_time<DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY user_id
), login_event AS (
 SELECT user_id,1 AS login_event_flag FROM haoshen_ods.app_login_log
 WHERE login_date>='${stat_date}' AND login_date<DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT '${stat_date}' AS log_date,u.user_id,u.agent_id,u.reg_date,
 CASE WHEN u.reg_date>='${stat_date}' AND u.reg_date<DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_user_flag,
 CASE WHEN u.last_login_date>='${stat_date}' AND u.last_login_date<DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active_snapshot_flag,
 COALESCE(l.login_event_flag,0) AS login_event_flag,
 CASE WHEN b.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bs_flag,
 CASE WHEN u.first_infull_time>='${stat_date}' AND u.first_infull_time<DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS first_pay_flag,
 p.payment_rows,p.distinct_orders,p.cash_amount,p.charge_coins
FROM haoshen_dwd.dwd_user_info_di u
LEFT JOIN pay p ON u.user_id=p.user_id
LEFT JOIN login_event l ON u.user_id=l.user_id
LEFT JOIN haoshen_ods.bs_user_id b ON u.user_id=b.user_id
WHERE u.log_date='${stat_date}';

WITH offsets AS (
 SELECT 2 AS retention_day,-1 AS offset_day UNION ALL SELECT 3,-2 UNION ALL SELECT 7,-6
 UNION ALL SELECT 15,-14 UNION ALL SELECT 30,-29
), counts AS (
 SELECT '${stat_date}' AS log_date,n.retention_day,
 DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL n.offset_day DAY) AS cohort_date,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN t.reg_date>=DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL n.offset_day DAY)
 AND t.reg_date<DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL n.offset_day DAY),INTERVAL 1 DAY)
 THEN t.user_id END) AS cohort_users,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN t.reg_date>=DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL n.offset_day DAY)
 AND t.reg_date<DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL n.offset_day DAY),INTERVAL 1 DAY)
 AND t.last_login_date>='${stat_date}' AND t.last_login_date<DATE_ADD('${stat_date}',INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN t.user_id END) AS returned_users
 FROM offsets n LEFT JOIN haoshen_dwd.dwd_user_info_di t ON t.log_date='${stat_date}'
 WHERE '${stat_date}'<'${data_complete_before}'
 GROUP BY n.retention_day,n.offset_day
) SELECT *,returned_users*1.0/NULLIF(cohort_users,0) AS retention_rate FROM counts;
